description: This file defines the 'tlUser' class responsible for handling user-related operations in the TestLink open source testing management platform. It includes methods for user creation, authentication, role management, permission checks, database interactions, and password management.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Class encapsulating user management, including CRUD operations, role and permission handling, password management, and security functions within the TestLink platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new user object, loading configuration, setting default values, and establishing database interaction parameters.

methods.name: readFromDB
methods.description: Fetches user data from the database based on user ID, login, or email, and populates the object properties.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Persists the user object into the database, performing insert or update operations depending on the presence of a primary key.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Assigns and encrypts a new password for the user.

methods.name: comparePassword
methods.description: Verifies if a given password matches the stored password, supporting migration from MD5 hashes to bcrypt.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable formatted name of the user.

methods.name: auth_generate_unique_cookie_string
methods.description: Generates a unique string for user session cookies, ensuring uniqueness across sessions.
